title: Founder Index resources
description: Every resource in the directory. One object per entry. Validated in CI on every commit — see scripts/validate.mjs for the rules a schema cannot express (word count, duplicate URLs, slug collisions).

name.description: What the thing is called. Must be unique across the file.

url.description: Canonical link. Required unless verify is true — an entry nobody has confirmed may sit here without one.

what.description: What it does for you, in plain words, in twelve words or fewer. Never marketing copy from the tool's own homepage.

stage.description: Which stage of the journey this belongs to.

category.description: Free text. Groups cards within a stage page. Reuse an existing category where one fits.

tags.description: Cross-cutting filters. May be empty. New tags need a pull request that adds them here first.

verify.description: True when nobody has confirmed the link or the description. Renders as a muted 'unverified' chip. Never quietly present a guess as a fact.

why.description: Optional one or two sentences of first-hand context. Why you reached for it, what it was actually like.

alternatives.description: Names of other entries in this file that do a similar job.

addedBy.description: GitHub handle of the contributor, without the @.

lastChecked.description: ISO date the link and description were last confirmed by a human.

affiliate.description: True if the url carries an affiliate or referral code. There is no paid placement here, but if a link ever pays us it must say so on the card. See About.
